The '''Borg construct Ax<sup>8</sup>''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] computer interface manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] that wrapped around the head. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Halina Patel]] wore one such implant.<ref name="GeharrIncident" />
